final: WITH item_averages AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_item_price, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0 THEN 1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost END) AS avg_item_cost_ratio FROM Order_Items oi JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city), town_averages AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_item_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_item_cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item_averages GROUP BY town_city), town_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS cross_town_avg_ratio FROM town_averages) SELECT ta.town_city, ta.avg_price, ta.avg_ratio, ta.avg_ratio - tb.cross_town_avg_ratio AS ratio_excess FROM town_averages ta CROSS JOIN town_baseline tb WHERE ta.avg_ratio > tb.cross_town_avg_ratio
